about: Public posts by people entering listed challenges. Verbatim excerpts (cuts marked …), each linking to the original. Checked against the X API on 2026-11-25.

posts.author: bigospeedrun
posts.name: Big O Speedrun
posts.text: New claim! · Problem: Integer Multiplication · New value: O(n log^(1 - 0.5 + epsilon) n), for every fixed epsilon > 0 · Player: OpenAI · Status: Claimed (not verified)

posts.author: bigospeedrun
posts.name: Big O Speedrun
posts.text: Race closed! (Claimed) Matrix multiplication: exponent 9/4, the best possible value · Player: OpenAI · Agent breakthrough: the matching lower bound, with a published Lean proof. No independent rebuild yet.

posts.author: CarinaLHong

posts.text: We have many LeanEval submissions. They are large, and there are technical challenges for LeanEval to accept them. … Should we just flip the repos public? This is a benchmark after all.
